_readme: Lunar target profile per base type, in the SAME terms as the Earth pipeline (src/pipeline/polar.py):
same criterion ids, units and definitions, computed on the same 60 m grid with the same windows.
The pipeline only uses a value when verified = true (set by whoever computed it from the named source).
No 0-1 scores here: the lunar site is the reference that Earth cells are scored against.
Draft numbers that do not match a pipeline definition are kept under draft_reference, unused.

polar.label: Shackleton rim + floor (lunar south pole)
polar.status: computed by src/moon_targets.py; verified=false until a person checks each value against the quicklook and the definition
polar.window: 15 km cell centred on Shackleton (-89.67, 129.8) in lunar south polar stereographic, read with polar.buffer_m = 5500 m; widest depression in the cell

c7_bowl.label: 7 Bowl shape
c7_bowl.definition: candidate places = closed depressions >= 50 m deep and >= 1000 m wide whose low point is in the window (searched with a 5 km margin); value = spill depth / equivalent diameter of the chosen place
c7_bowl.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (NASA PGDA; native 20 m) -> 60 m bilinear, src/moon_targets.py, 2026-11-14

c9_relief.label: 9 Relief ~5 km
c9_relief.definition: max - min elevation in a 5 km square centred on the chosen depression's low point
c9_relief.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (NASA PGDA; native 20 m) -> 60 m bilinear, src/moon_targets.py, 2026-11-14

c10_flat_base.label: 10 Flat base spot
c10_flat_base.definition: mean slope of the flattest ~200 m pad (3x3 px at 60 m) whose centre is within 5 km of the low point
c10_flat_base.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (NASA PGDA; native 20 m) -> 60 m bilinear, src/moon_targets.py, 2026-11-14
c10_flat_base.note: TODO: with max_base_to_low_km = 5 the pad is searched within 5 km of the low point, i.e. on Shackleton's floor/lower wall (permanently dark), not on the rim where NASA's base sites are (~10 km out). Kept as is for v1; revisit the search radius.

c11_walls.label: 11 Steep walls
c11_walls.definition: mean slope in a 500-3000 m ring around the low point
c11_walls.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (NASA PGDA; native 20 m) -> 60 m bilinear, src/moon_targets.py, 2026-11-14
c11_walls.note: TODO: the wall ring (polar.wall_ring_m = 500-3000 m from the low point) covers Shackleton's floor and the foot of its walls; the steep inner walls run ~3-10 km out, so this value understates them. Kept as is for v1; revisit a ring scaled to the depression size.

c13_roughness.label: 13 Roughness
c13_roughness.definition: median std of elevation in 3x3 px windows over the window
c13_roughness.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (NASA PGDA; native 20 m) -> 60 m bilinear, src/moon_targets.py, 2026-11-14

c14_aspect.label: 14 Pole-facing slopes
c14_aspect.definition: share of steep pixels (> 20 deg) within 3 km of the low point facing the nearer pole (+-45 deg)
c14_aspect.note: Shackleton's rim touches the lunar south pole and the Sun circles the whole horizon there, so 'facing the pole' does not mean 'less sun' as it does on Earth. Computed value kept in the note for reference only. Computed: 0.415.

sunny_ridge.pipeline: light criteria 1-5 via src/shadowsim, not wired into run_pipeline yet
sunny_ridge.note: 0.85 was an illustrative placeholder from a chat format example, not a measurement. TODO: compute rim lit fraction (step 3, illumination).

dark_floor.pipeline: light criteria 1-5 via src/shadowsim, not wired in yet

relief_rim_floor.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_dem.py (30 m crop): rim median 1115 m, floor min -2872 m (data/results/moon_dem_summary.json)
relief_rim_floor.why_unused: crater rim-to-floor depth, not c9 (5 km window at the low point); recompute c9 from LOLA
relief_rim_floor.note: replaces a 4100 m placeholder from a chat format example. Spill depth (lowest rim saddle to floor) is 3752.5 m, see polar.computed.spill_depth_m.

bare_ground.why_unused: land cover is a hard filter in the Earth pipeline (config filter), not a scored criterion

draft_scores.why_unused: 0-1 scores for the target itself have no source and no meaning in the scoring: Earth cells are scored against the lunar raw values
